sentences.text: Yesterday I went to the park with my dog.
He loves chasing the ducks there.
Then he ran into the road.
A car hit him.
The vet said he will not make it.
We sat with him until the end.
I still miss him every day.
Guess what happened today!
I got the job at the bakery!
They called me this morning.
I start on Monday.
The only problem is that I have to wake up at four.
Four in the morning, can you believe it?
Still, I am so happy.
I ordered a new phone two weeks ago.
It still has not arrived.
Today the shop told me they lost it.
And they refuse to give my money back!
I called them five times.
Nobody answers.
This is ridiculous.
It has been a very long day.
I worked for twelve hours.
I can barely keep my eyes open.
Maybe I will just watch something.
This show is so slow and boring.
Nothing happens in it at all.
Good night.
Let me tell you about my birthday.
I walked into my apartment and the lights were off.
Suddenly everyone jumped out and shouted surprise!
I could not believe it!
All my friends were there.
Look at the cake on the left.
It was the best day of my life.
I had my driving test this morning.
I was so nervous.
I failed the first part.
The examiner was really rude to me.
But then I passed the rest!
I finally have my license!
My mom cried when I told her.
Hey, are you awake?
I need your help with something.
Look up at the shelf.
Do you see the red box?
Now look down at the floor.
Great job, thank you!
You are the best.
It has been raining all week.
I could not go outside even once.
I feel so lonely.
Then my sister called me.
She is coming to visit tomorrow!
We are going to bake cookies together.
I can't wait.
My neighbor plays loud music every night.
Last night it went on until three.
I knocked on his door and he laughed at me!
I was furious.
This morning he left a note and some flowers.
He said he was sorry.
Okay, maybe he is not so bad.
Today we had a three hour meeting.
The manager read every slide out loud.
I almost fell asleep.
Then he announced that the company was sold!
Nobody saw that coming.
Everyone got a big bonus.
Best meeting ever!
